1.mascotDialogue: The pivot no dey move again after partitioning — she don already reach home! Everything wey remain to sort na strictly smaller for one side, strictly bigger for the other.

2.mascotDialogue: Line 9 dey place the pivot for her final resting index. Lines 16 and 17 recurse for the strictly-smaller and strictly-bigger side — the pivot herself never touched again.

3.mascotDialogue: This pivot happen to be the smallest value, so she end up all the way for index 0 — unlucky pivot choice, and good example of why selection matter for performance.

4.mascotDialogue: One character out of place — p instead of p minus one — and the recursion go lose her most important guarantee: every recursive call must work for strictly smaller range pass the one before.
